title: Bound all mechanical momentum fluctuations and Gaussian energy excess with one bounded quantum force
statement: For H=H_G+H_A-lambda Q v^Tq with coordinate-only bounded Hermitian Q and C=v^TK^-1v, Chi_n=G_n+lambda^2 G_n v S_n v^T G_n, S_n>=0. Thus Gamma_p-Gamma_p,G=-(lambda^2/beta)sum nu_n^2 S_n(MG_nv)(MG_nv)^T<=0; Var(Y)-Var_G(Y)<=lambda^2 C^2 Var(Q), total spring increase<=E* and kinetic decrease<=E*/4.

requires: Positive constant Gaussian mass/spring matrices, finite internal H_A, one bounded Hermitian force Q, coordinate-only coupling and actual interacting Gibbs state. Uniform C for the stated lead limit.
provides: For H=H_G+H_A-lambda Q v^Tq with coordinate-only bounded Hermitian Q and C=v^TK^-1v, Chi_n=G_n+lambda^2 G_n v S_n v^T G_n, S_n>=0. Thus Gamma_p-Gamma_p,G=-(lambda^2/beta)sum nu_n^2 S_n(MG_nv)(MG_nv)^T<=0; Var(Y)-Var_G(Y)<=lambda^2 C^2 Var(Q), total spring increase<=E* and kinetic decrease<=E*/4.
assumptions: No momentum coupling, arbitrary additional thermal port or arbitrary infinite auxiliary is included. The rotor extension uses its separately proved cutoff/form/trace argument. Equilibrium bounds do not acquire a preparation clock or heat law.
costs: E*=lambda^2 C q_*^2/2 is explicit spring-energy excess. Counterterm/internal energy, actual force coupling, physical source, preparation and readout are separately counted.
contract.units: Chi,G are mechanical susceptibility/compliance; Gamma_p is momentum covariance; E* is energy. beta is inverse energy and nu_n=2pi n/(beta hbar) frequency.
contract.obstruction: Replace projected/free-internal correlations and omitted-lead energy accounting with full interacting covariance and explicit signed excess bounds.

body: Apply the exact time-ordered mechanical EOM twice, preserving the equal-time canonical contact; cross q,Q has no contact because the operators act on separate sectors. The interacting KMS Lehmann representation gives S_n>=0 and beta^-1 sum S_n=Var(Q). Keep the momentum contact series combined, then subtract the unchanged free Gaussian expression. Scalar spectral inequalities for D=M^-1/2KM^-1/2 give spring/kinetic constants1/2 and1/8. Include the mean displacement and separately specified counterterms. Positive local spring/kinetic sums permit the bounded-compliance local lead limit without declaring the infinite baseline finite.
